report.previous_run_delta: New: Vercel made Ling 3.0 Flash Sante free through October 4 with a charge-safe -free model identifier. Recovered/closing: MiniMax M3 and M2.7 remain free through September 6, leaving roughly one day to benchmark the 1M-context coding/agent model. Program-surface scan rejected Runway Builders and Ultralytics for present use because their valuable tiers require funded startups and workload-specific product fit. Mireye, K2 Horizon, and Scaleway were unchanged and not recycled.

signals.classification: CONFIRMED CLOSING WINDOW; PRIMARY PRICING VERIFIED
signals.changed: Recovered before expiry: Vercel AI Gateway is serving MiniMax M3 and M2.7 through GMI Cloud at zero inference price through September 6. The dedicated -free model IDs stop serving after the promotion rather than converting to paid traffic.
signals.free_value: MiniMax M3 API access with a 1M-token context window, coding and agentic capability, native multimodality, and OpenAI/AI-SDK-compatible access; M2.7 offers a 197K context route focused on software engineering.
signals.approximate_value: Usage limits are not publicly quantified, so the dollar value cannot be verified. The value is a bounded, no-inference-cost benchmark of a frontier-class long-context model on an existing repository.
signals.cash_required: $0 for promotional inference; a Vercel account and API key are required. No payment is needed for the dedicated -free route.
signals.catch: Promotion ends September 6; provider capacity may constrain throughput; model/provider terms apply; no published quota supports an unlimited-use claim.

signals.classification: CONFIRMED FRESH LAUNCH; PRIMARY PRICING VERIFIED
signals.changed: On September 4, Vercel added Ling 3.0 Flash Sante to AI Gateway and made it free through October 4, including a dedicated -free ID that hard-stops at expiry.
signals.free_value: A 124B-total/5.1B-active mixture-of-experts model with a 256K context window, up to 32K output, function calling, medical reasoning, evidence-based retrieval, and retained general coding/agent capability.
signals.approximate_value: Unquantified promotional inference. Free Vercel users also receive $5 of gateway credits every 30 days, but the promotional route itself is priced at zero through October 4.
signals.catch: No public promotional quota was found; provider privacy terms apply; the model page does not establish zero-data-retention or no-training guarantees; it must not be used as clinical authority or with private health data.

program_surface_results: Runway Builders advertises up to 500,000 API credits and Tier 5 limits, but targets Seed-to-Series-C startups and asks for funding stage plus a Runway Characters use case; it was excluded as a poor current fit.
Ultralytics advertises up to $10,000, but explicitly requires institutional Seed-or-later funding, a central computer-vision product, and a use case within 90 days; it was excluded.
Google Agents for Impact currently offers future event/hackathon access rather than guaranteed operating credits and would introduce travel or a future build commitment; it was excluded.
omissions_errors: Vercel does not publish promotional request or token quotas for the MiniMax or Ling free routes; no unlimited-use claim is made.
MiniMax M3 capability descriptions are provider/publisher claims and were not independently benchmarked in this run.
Ling Sante was not clinically evaluated in this run and is not recommended for private health data or medical decision-making.
No new bootstrapped-fit program at Devin-class magnitude survived verification.
